description: React component for rendering a public blog post page with route parameter validation, post fetching via Convex query stub, content parsing and rendering with minimal HTML conversion, and SEO metadata management.

methods.name: extractText
methods.description: Extracts plain text from a TipTap node tree.

methods.name: escapeHtml
methods.description: Escapes special HTML characters in a string.

methods.name: escapeAttr

methods.name: stripHtml

methods.name: humanizeSlug
methods.description: Converts slug string to human-readable format by replacing dashes with spaces and capitalizing words.
